target_semantics: target copied bit-exactly from stabilized source-terminal needle tip
success_definition: terminal_tip_world_m component-wise bit-equal to terminal_target_world_m; float64 Euclidean error exactly 0.0 um

action_space.raw_action_semantics: quantized MotorBackend absolute A/B/C target for the following interval; converter stores target minus current state

oct_navigation.invalid_policy: fallback, exact-terminal and hold frames are zero with valid=false; a visual callback without a matching OCT row is also invalid
oct_navigation.scope: Target-relative navigation input for an OCT-guided policy. This is simulation RGB-D used as the OCT navigation value, not a physical OCT acquisition.
